{{Infobox/Location |type = {{Skl|Fishing|Island}} |level = {{Skill|Fishing|10}} |image= {{InfoboxGallery |image1 = Lotus Atoll.png|label1 = Island |image2 = Lotus Atoll (0.25) (Top View).png|label2 = Top View }} |prev_location=[[Backwater Bayou]] |level {{Skill|Fishing|10}} |sublocations = * [[Lotus Eater's Cave]] * [[Lotus Highlands]] * [[Tewtil Tunnel]] |travel_scroll = [[Travel Scroll to the Lotus Atoll]] |mobs = * Atoll Croaker * Drowned Captain * Flipflopper * Frog Prince * gorF * Lotum * Lotus Guardian * Lotusfish * Puddle Jumper * Seashine * Tewtil |drops = |resources = }} {{For|the temporary promotional NPC|Lotus Atoll (NPC)}} The '''Lotus Atoll''' is a {{Skl|Fishing}} [[Locations|Location]] and the second island that can be accessed from [[Ship Navigator]]. It is unlocked by reaching {{Skill|Fishing|10}} and speaking to {{NPCSprite|Researcher Gilbert}} on the {{Zone|Backwater Bayou}}. {{ZoneText|Learn about &2Trophy Frogs &ffrom &2Researcher Ribery&f.|Catch the &212 species &fof Trophy Frog.|Trade Frogs with &2Researcher Ribery &fin exchange for &aLotus&f.|Progress through the &aLotus Collection&f!}} == Features == The '''Lotus Atoll''' is a [[Fishing]]-oriented location, with a variety of unique features resolving around progress in the skill. === Chapters === The '''Lotus Atoll''' contains [[Chapters]], which consist of {{Yellow|47}} tasks for the player to complete. Completing all these tasks rewards the {{Item|Pearl of the Lotus}}, which grants a permanent {{Stat|trophy chance|+2.5}}. These chapters can be accessed by speaking to {{NPCSprite|Researcher Betty}}. {{:Chapters/Lotus Atoll}} === Sea Creatures === The '''Lotus Atoll''' contains a variety of unique [[Sea Creatures]] to be caught. {{:Sea Creatures/List/Lotus}} === Treasure === {{Main|Treasure#Lotus Atoll}} '''Lotus Atoll''' has a unique [[Treasure#Lotus Atoll|Treasure Fishing]] loot table. === Critters === Aside from [[Sea Creatures]], there are various [[Critters]] that can be found on the '''Lotus Atoll''', all of which are tied to [[Hunting]] and cannot be damaged regularly: * {{MobSprite|Lotusfish}}, which can be found swimming in the water and caught with a [[Fishing Nets|Fishing Net]] to obtain the {{Item|Lotusfish Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Lotum}}s, which can be found around the water. When punched 4 times (or 3 times with {{Attr|Frog Legs}}), they grant the {{Item|Lotum Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Tewtil}}s, which can be found in the water and primarily in the {{Zone|Tewtil Tunnel}}. When fed three [[Trophy Frog]]s, they explode and grant the {{Item|Tewtil Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Flipflopper}}s, which have a {{Green|50%}} chance to spawn from an [[Exploding Lily Pad]]. They can be damaged with a {{Item|Medium Fishing Net}} or better. * {{MobSprite|Seashine}}s, which have a {{Green|25%}} chance to spawn from an [[Exploding Lily Pad]]. They can also be damaged with a {{Item|Medium Fishing Net}} or better. === Lotus Collection === {{Main|Lotus}} {{Item|Lotus}} is a [[Collection]] that is obtained exclusively on the '''Lotus Atoll'''. It features items that make it easier to catch [[Trophy Frogs]]. {{CollectionTable|Lotus}} === Trophy Frogs === {{Main|Trophy Frog}} [[Trophy Frogs]] are a type of item that can be caught exclusively on the '''Lotus Atoll'''. Like [[Trophy Fish]], each type of Trophy Frog comes in four tiers: {{Dark Gray|'''BRONZE'''}}, {{Gray|'''SILVER'''}}, {{Gold|'''GOLD'''}}, and {{Aqua|'''DIAMOND'''}}, with higher tiers being harder to catch. {{:Trophy Frogs/List}} === Wormholes === [[File:Lotus Atoll Wormhole.png|thumb|256px|A Wormhole under a bridge near the spawn area.]] {{Main|Wormhole}} [[Wormhole]]s are purple particle rings that can be seen in the '''Lotus Atoll''' and {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} while wearing {{Item|Froggles}}, {{Item|Silver Froggles}}, {{Item|Golden Froggles}}, or {{Item|Diamond Froggles}}. While fishing in them, players have a chance to catch the {{Item|Reality Hopper}} [[Trophy Frog]]. Higher tier Froggles and the {{Item|Geometric Oddity}} also grant {{Stat|trophy chance}} and higher chances at {{Gold|'''GOLD'''}} and {{Aqua|'''DIAMOND'''}} [[Trophy Frogs]]. Additionally, fishing inside a [[Wormhole]] prevents [[Sea Creatures]] from being caught. === Exploding Lily Pads === [[File:Giant Lily Pad.png|thumb|256px|A large lily pad right before explosion.]] The water in the '''Lotus Atoll''' not only contains {{Item|Lily Pad}}s placed as blocks, but also lily pads that can be punched around on the water. If two Lily Pads of different sizes get close together, the smaller one will be absorbed by the larger one, which also increases the size of the larger Lily Pad. Once a single Lily Pad reaches size 8, it will float into the air, spin, and then explode. The explosion grants the following rewards to all players within 30 blocks who interacted with the Lily Pad (including merged Lily Pads) during the past 180 seconds: * {{Item|Exploding Frog}} [[Trophy Frog]] * {{Item|Lily Pad|amount=120-180}}s{{confirm}} * {{Item|Lotus|amount=60-100}} * {{Skill XP|+120 Fishing}} After a Lily Pad explodes, 3-5 [[Sea Creatures#Lotus|Lotus Sea Creatures]] spawn based on the sum of the participating players' {{Stat|Tracking}} (up to {{Staticon|Tracking|400}}{{Confirm}}). Each Sea Creature targets a random participating player. There is also a {{Green|50%}} base chance to spawn a {{MobSprite|Flipflopper}} and a {{Green|25%}} base chance to spawn {{MobSprite|Seashine}}, which can be increased by the participants' {{Stat|Tracking}}. {{Attr|Lily Tracker}} [[Attribute]] grants {{Stat|Tracking}} on Exploding Lily Pads and {{Attr|Lily Puncher}} [[Attribute]] gives more force when punching them. {{Dialogue| &b&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ &a&lLILY-SPLOSION! &a&lREWARDS &fLily Pad &8x# &aLotus &8x# &3+# Fishing Experience &aExploding Frog &7&l &b&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ }} File:Pushable lily pads next to normal lily pads.png|A group of pushable lily pads next to normal lily pads. File:Giant Lily Pad.png|A large lily pad right before explosion. File:Giant Lily Pad floating up.png|A lily pad spinning in the air before exploding. [[File:Fishing Hot Spot in Lotus Atoll.png|thumb|256px|An example of a hotspot in the Lotus Atoll.]] === Hotspots === [[Fishing Hotspots|Hotspots]] appear in water to grant buffs and new [[Sea Creatures]] when the player's bobber is within. === Weather === Every {{Green|40}} minutes on the '''Lotus Atoll''', {{Green|20}} minutes of rain begins. While raining, players gain {{stat|fs|+25}} and can catch {{Item|Wetlands Frog}}s. Occasionally, rain may become a thunderstorm.
